outcome: Extubation failure in very low birth weight infants
cohort: Very low birth weight infants (gestational age ≤ 32 weeks or birth weight ≤ 1500 grams) admitted to the NICU between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2019
finding: Gestational age, birth weight, antenatal steroid use, mode of delivery, number of Survanta doses, PEEP, MAP, mean arterial pressure, and infectious diseases were significant predictors of extubation failure in very low birth weight infants.
country: Al Ain (not specified, but likely United Arab Emirates)
